scope: Current INT-05 only:20seat candidates plus2operator kinds,41 frozen variants,58 exact candidate axes. No runtime edits/builds/tests/gameplay/fullHC acceptance.
commonPipeline: One coherent authorized current observation with actual internally bound principal/command-specific grant; no caller authority, raw snapshot or cross-principal receipt access.

Select actual visible actor/source/target/context values using the exact registered current predicates and pure selectors. Do not execute handlers, private condition folds, replay, validation that reconstructs dice, or lifecycle to discover examples.

Construct finite native payload candidates per frozen kind/variant and constructor semantics. Preserve native list order/canonicalization. Empty sentinel,nullobject,zero and actual identity remain distinct.

GPT06 Core-owned comparison orders the exact existing Command.Fingerprint with StringComparer.Ordinal within each kind/variant at common current ExpectedRevision. Never export fingerprint or duplicate serialization. Parent owns exact outer/Core API.
Coalesce genuinely identical canonical payload candidates, retaining all recipe/axis associations. Different effective payloads with equal keys are a concrete blocker, not a dictionary/id tie-break.
Assign example ordinals and base36 hc1 IDs after candidate authorization and canonical ordering; same-principal current collision handling only. No hidden actor/receipt/candidate affects rank or ID.
Apply actual payload constructors, Command.Id and all exact native derived-ID constraints after IDs exist. Then shared pure admission. No reservation, receipt, save, RNG or clock mutation.

Publish only authorized exact examples and approved assessment diagnostics. Example construction and conditional descriptors do not prove a futurehit,save,KO,Press,Sanctuary,hiddenobserver,contact,terminalevent or successfulcommit.

orderingDecision.withinVariant: StringComparer.Ordinal on existing Core Command.Fingerprint; not numeric rational/coordinate or typed tuple order.
orderingDecision.acrossVariants: Existing numeric CommandKind then frozen variantOrdinal from PARAMETER_CONTRACT_INDEX.
orderingDecision.sourceCorrection: GPT06 supersedes stale EXAMPLE_DOMAIN_ORDER and candidateExamplePolicy tuple/numeric order prose. Those inputs are retained for history/variant allocation only. Pending-choice priority/result-instance order remain separate.
orderingDecision.coreBoundary: No publicfingerprint, friendassembly, duplicate parser, alternate serializer or independent mutable parameter path is proposed here.

CURRENT_AUTHORIZED_ACTOR.source: Current internally bound endpoint principal/grant and selected variant actorDomain; no caller Authority.
CURRENT_AUTHORIZED_ACTOR.publicBoundary: Only currently controlled/allowed actors actually admitted by this selected composition. Source-specific hostile seats are distinct; no manual Grounded-creature or opponent authority is added.
CURRENT_AUTHORIZED_ACTOR.emptiness: No authorized source actor -> no concrete candidate.

CURRENT_TURN.source: Exact current Encounter.CurrentTurnId after appropriate own/response context disclosure.
CURRENT_TURN.forbidden: Do not synthesize from exampleID, slot number or retained old turn. Operator reads only its allowed coarse/command-target boundary.

VISIBLE_ROSTER_TARGETS.source: Actual authorized source actor visible nonself roster identities from existing current observation route.
VISIBLE_ROSTER_TARGETS.constraint: Do not prefilter by privateHP,save,condition,effect,hidden readiness or hypothetical Sanctuary outcome. Native current assessment handles legal target constraints with agreed redaction.

HELD_OWNED_CLUBS.source: Actual ClubInstance.Id with actor HeldBy/custody/held-items binding and current grant.MayUseInventory(OwnerId); exact selected native club profile.
HELD_OWNED_CLUBS.constraint: No lookup through arbitrary other-owner rawinventory. No synthetic weapon or granting custody.

CURRENT_PENDING.source: Exact existing current authorized pending owner/identity under the frozen decision priority.
CURRENT_PENDING.priorityRef: Input pendingPriority; actual Sanctuary,KO,OA,Press controls keep real identities.
CURRENT_PENDING.constraint: Expose only current owner decision, never queued reactor list/count or a future KO/Press/Sanctuary offer. Actual source/captured instruction remains privately bound; immutable.

VISIBLE_PARTY_SUBSETS.source: Subset of the actual source-visible authorized Hero/Companion identities named by the selected Presence profile.
VISIBLE_PARTY_SUBSETS.construction: Generate all nonempty subsets of the authorized two-ID set; native IntimidatingPresenceRequest validates distinctIDs and canonicalizes ordinal order.
VISIBLE_PARTY_SUBSETS.constraint: If one member lacks independent visibility, omit only subsets containing that member. No hiddeneligibility filtering, thirdParty actor or extra source seat.

TACTICAL_ADJACENT_CELLS.source: Current disclosed native integer actor origin.
TACTICAL_ADJACENT_CELLS.construction: Checked Int64 origin+offset arithmetic; require result representableInt32. These are geometric candidates, not eight legal moves.
TACTICAL_ADJACENT_CELLS.constraint: Do not discard based on hidden blockers/opponents/press/OA prediction. Native geometry/capability/occupancy and safe current assessment remain controlling.

WORLD_CARDINAL_DELTAS.construction: Payload is delta, never absolute destination. Check native representable addition before assessment.
WORLD_CARDINAL_DELTAS.constraint: Retain Target walk/run and existing running, budget, charter, reinforcement and geometry rules.

SEARCH_PUBLIC_CELLS.source: Same finite map/range geometric enumeration as SharedObservationActions.cs161-166 and SharedExplorationSearch.cs68-90, under approved pure own-context reads.
SEARCH_PUBLIC_CELLS.construction: For actual disclosed ObservationMapWidth/Height, form each in-bounds integercell; include cells within the actual source SearchRangeFeet from current tactical search pose or exact ordinary Search anchor.
SEARCH_PUBLIC_CELLS.finiteBound: At most ObservationMapWidth*ObservationMapHeight candidatecells per actor/election, with checked size arithmetic and existing validatedmap bounds. No new coordinate bound/truncation or smallest step is invented.
SEARCH_PUBLIC_CELLS.descriptorKind: Constrained geometry/range domain; enumeration covers these public geometric candidates, not all legal committed commands.
SEARCH_PUBLIC_CELLS.privacy: No target, hiddenobserver, ObserverKnowledge, Stealth, DC or would-find-something input enters enumeration/count/order. Read selectors must not invoke lifecycle or search resolvers.

GUIDANCE_ELECTIONS.source: Existing current authorized GuidanceBenefits for actual recipient plus selected tactical consumer/profile and pure initial shape/eligibility.
GUIDANCE_ELECTIONS.construction: One candidate per actual eligible effect identity, never an invented effect. None elected belongs to the separate decline variant.
GUIDANCE_ELECTIONS.constraint: No hiddenobserver/check predicate controls examples. Actual check/consumption is conditional; Hide linkage stays fixed Withheld underGPT05. Actual .medicine derivedID bound retained.

ACTUAL_SEAL.source: Existing exposed-seal observation and current source actor access; exact FerryWraithProfile.Seal identity.
ACTUAL_SEAL.constraint: No raw hidden suppression, enemy state, stored but unseen seal location or repeated-use prediction; no observed seal means no concrete example.

ACTUAL_OWN_TRAVERSAL.source: Actual source-controlled WorldTraversalRecord selected by variantstatus/context.
ACTUAL_OWN_TRAVERSAL.constraint: Reuse current edge, running mode and partial pose. Commands cannot replace destination, turn walking into running or refundpaidbudget.

ORDINARY_START_TOKENS.source: Exact existing HideStartToken or SearchStartToken for the selected owned actor/context.
ORDINARY_START_TOKENS.constraint: No synthetic marker or retry receipt; no journal/lifecycle reconstruction to obtain a token.

ACTUAL_REINFORCEMENT.source: Exact existing selected Reinforcement.Definition and current Companion controller; existing immutable factory consent/director/side/tie configuration.
ACTUAL_REINFORCEMENT.constraint: No new consent command, no fabricated flag, no extra grant or alternative route. These are read-only selected setup facts, not candidate input parameters.

OPERATOR_ONLY.source: Actual session operator boundary with SessionPrincipal ClockGrant/CloseGrant and canonical Actor=Hero.
OPERATOR_ONLY.constraint: This spelling of Actor never grants character observation, inventory, participant or enemy authority. Do not use operator privileges to enumerate seat candidates.

ACTUAL_OWN_ORDINARY_PROCEDURE.source: Exact existing ExplorationHide.Pending or ExplorationSearch.Pending for the actual selected controlled actor.
ACTUAL_OWN_ORDINARY_PROCEDURE.constraint: Read actual procedure Id after actor/current disclosure. This is not an extra member of the ActingActor tactical five-kind priority; native cancellation conflict gates remain in shared pure admission. No manufactured token or queued procedural outcome.
